notes: Zoom 1 preserves the current softened logarithmic world-history distribution.
As time zoom increases, the visible interval continuously blends toward equal spacing per historical ordinal; by zoom 16 the local interval is linear.
BC 1 and AD 1 remain adjacent through the existing historical ordinal contract and year 0 is never introduced.
Pointer-centered zoom solves the camera center against the semantic time projection so the historical instant beneath the pointer does not drift while the blend changes.
This phase is an isolated projection/navigation core only. The production v1 timeline remains authoritative until a later renderer cutover.
